REMARKS:

012200Z POSITION NEAR 22.3N 165.7W.

01OCT26. TROPICAL STORM 15E (NOLO), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 317 NM

WEST OF BARKING SANDS, HAS TRACKED NORTHWESTWARD AT 03 KNOTS OVER

THE PAST SIX HOURS.

MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT 011800Z IS 993 MB. MAXIMUM

SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 011800Z IS 20 FEET. NEXT WARNINGS AT

020400Z, 021000Z, 021600Z AND 022200Z.

REFER TO HURRICANE 18E (RACHEL) WARNINGS (WTPN34 PHNC)

FOR SIX-HOURLY UPDATES.

REFER TO REMNANTS OF 19E (NINETEEN) FINAL WARNING (WTPN31 PHNC).//
